summary: Adds a RObust Header Compression profile for compressing plain IP headers on their own, filling a gap left by the original ROHC framework in RFC 3095. That earlier document covered IP/UDP/RTP, IP/ESP and IP/UDP but not IP alone.

eli5.summary: A message with a long address on every page can use a short code instead. This document adds a short-code method for messages that only have the basic address part.

questions: header compression for ip packets without udp
